feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 24 September 2026 10:27pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 24 September 2026 at 10:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred over Germany, and a deep area of low pressure over Iceland bringing a cold front overnight.


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6, but 4 in the southeast of the area, soon easing 4 or 5, then veering westerly 3 or 4 in all waters overnight. Backing southwest by midday, then increasing 4 or 5 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, but slight to the southeast becoming slight in all waters later tonight.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain soon becoming widespread, becoming mainly fair by midday tomorrow, only isolated showers later.


##Visibility##

Good, soon falling moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, increasing 6 in the north of the area for a time overnight into Saturday. Then increasing south or southwest 5 or 6 in all waters late Saturday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight building mainly moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
